NFSMW 2012 - MOD - All Races Open Mod
BY: freemanHL

Installation:
Drag and drop scripts folder and dinput8.dll to your nfsmw2012 game folder where NFS13.exe is located

Linux / Steam Deck Launch Command:
WINEDLLOVERRIDES="dinput8=n,b" %command%

Developed and Tested on Cachyos with nvidia gpu - runner: protoncachyos-slr

Github:
https://github.com/dougbug589/All-Races-Open-ARO

Github Releases:
https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/releases/latest

AI (Claude) was used to create this mod,and testing,reporting was done by me
